function zoneTarget(z){
 if(!z)return null;
 if(z.type==='circle')return {lat:z.lat,lng:z.lng};
 if(z.type==='corridor')return {lat:(z.a.lat+z.b.lat)/2,lng:(z.a.lng+z.b.lng)/2};
 return null
}
function bearingDeg(a,b){
 const y=Math.sin(rad(b.lng-a.lng))*Math.cos(rad(b.lat));
 const x=Math.cos(rad(a.lat))*Math.sin(rad(b.lat))-Math.sin(rad(a.lat))*Math.cos(rad(b.lat))*Math.cos(rad(b.lng-a.lng));
 return (Math.atan2(y,x)*180/Math.PI+360)%360
}
function arrowForBearing(d){
 const arrows=['↑','↗','→','↘','↓','↙','←','↖'];return arrows[Math.round(d/45)%8]
}

function currentSkin(){return OSO_SKINS.find(x=>x.id===state.selectedSkin)||OSO_SKINS[0]}
function currentOsoSrc(){return currentSkin().src}
const BASE_GAME_CODES=['basket','fish','stack','run','slice','tteok','powerduck'];
const BONUS_GAME_CODES=['spacefighter','racing','fantasy'];
function ensureSpacefighterUnlock(){
 if(state.unlock&&state.unlock.spacefighter)return false;
 if(BASE_GAME_CODES.every(c=>state.unlock&&state.unlock[c])){
  state.unlock.spacefighter=true;save();return true
 }
 return false
}
function ensureScoreBonusUnlocks(){
 const newly=[],n=Number(state.todayScore)||0;
 if(n>=500000&&!state.unlock.racing){state.unlock.racing=true;newly.push('racing')}
 if(n>=1000000&&!state.unlock.fantasy){state.unlock.fantasy=true;newly.push('fantasy')}
 if(newly.length){
  const q=Array.isArray(state.pendingBonusUnlocks)?state.pendingBonusUnlocks:[];
  state.pendingBonusUnlocks=[...new Set([...q,...newly])];
  save()
 }
 return newly
}

 return `${y}-${m}-${day}`

let state=load()||{unlock:{},best:{},coins:0,todayEarned:0,todayScore:0,scoreDate:localDateKey(),pdRecord:0,coinDate:localDateKey(),ranking:[],todaySubmittedBest:0,rankRegisteredBest:11,ownedSkins:['default'],selectedSkin:'default'};
if(!state.best||typeof state.best!=='object')state.best={};
if(!Array.isArray(state.ranking))state.ranking=[];
if(!Array.isArray(state.ownedSkins))state.ownedSkins=['default'];
if(!state.gpsCalibration)state.gpsCalibration={};
if(!state.gpsUnlocked)state.gpsUnlocked={};
if(!state.qrUnlocked)state.qrUnlocked={};
if(!state.ownedSkins.includes('default'))state.ownedSkins.unshift('default');
if(!state.selectedSkin||!state.ownedSkins.includes(state.selectedSkin))state.selectedSkin='default';
if(state.todayEarned==null)state.todayEarned=0;
if(state.todayScore==null)state.todayScore=0;
if(!state.scoreDate)state.scoreDate=localDateKey();
if(state.todaySubmittedBest==null)state.todaySubmittedBest=0;
if(state.rankRegisteredBest==null){
 state.rankRegisteredBest=Number.isFinite(state.dailyRankPromptedBestRank)?state.dailyRankPromptedBestRank:11;
}
if(state.scoreDate!==localDateKey()){
 state.scoreDate=localDateKey();
}

if(state.coinDate!==localDateKey())state.coinDate=localDateKey();
if(DEV_ALL_UNLOCKED)GAMES.forEach(g=>state.unlock[g.code]=true);

function ensureDailyScoreDate(){
 const today=localDateKey();
 if(!state.scoreDate)state.scoreDate=today;
 if(state.scoreDate!==today){
  state.scoreDate=today;
  save();
 }
}

 {initials:'오소',score:500000,date:'기준',ts:2,seed:true},
 {initials:'또오소',score:300000,date:'기준',ts:3,seed:true},

const RANK_SCORE_THRESHOLDS=DEFAULT_RANKING_SEED.map((r,i)=>({rank:i+1,score:Number(r.score)||0}));
function rankReachedByDailyScore(score){
 const n=Number(score)||0;
 for(const t of RANK_SCORE_THRESHOLDS){if(n>t.score)return t.rank}
 return 11;
}

function ensureRankRegistrationState(){
 if(state.rankRegistrationVersion==='threshold-record-v2')return;
 const userRows=(Array.isArray(state.ranking)?state.ranking:[]).filter(r=>!r.seed);
 let inferredBestRank=11;
 for(const row of userRows){
  const rr=Number.isFinite(row.rankReached)?row.rankReached:rankReachedByDailyScore(row.score);
  inferredBestRank=Math.min(inferredBestRank,rr);
 }
 state.rankRegisteredBest=inferredBestRank;
 state.rankRegistrationVersion='threshold-record-v2';
 save();
}
function ensureDefaultRanking(){
 const mode=state.rankingModeVersion;
 if(mode==='daily-score-v1'||mode==='daily-score-v2'){
  state.rankingModeVersion='daily-score-v2';
  return;
 }
 state.ranking=DEFAULT_RANKING_SEED.map(r=>({...r}));
 state.rankingModeVersion='daily-score-v2';
 state.todaySubmittedBest=0;
 state.rankRegisteredBest=11;
 save();
}
function currentRankCutoff(){
 const rows=rankingSorted();
 return rows.length<10?0:(rows[9]?.score||0);
}
ensureDefaultRanking();
ensureRankRegistrationState();

const RANK_SCORE_THRESHOLDS=DEFAULT_RANKING_SEED.map((r,i)=>({rank:i+1,score:Number(r.score)||0}));
function rankReachedByDailyScore(score){
 const n=Number(score)||0;
 for(const t of RANK_SCORE_THRESHOLDS){if(n>t.score)return t.rank}
 return 11;
}

function ensureRankRegistrationState(){
 if(state.rankRegistrationVersion==='threshold-record-v2')return;
 const userRows=(Array.isArray(state.ranking)?state.ranking:[]).filter(r=>!r.seed);
 let inferredBestRank=11;
 for(const row of userRows){
  const rr=Number.isFinite(row.rankReached)?row.rankReached:rankReachedByDailyScore(row.score);
  inferredBestRank=Math.min(inferredBestRank,rr);
 }
 state.rankRegisteredBest=inferredBestRank;
 state.rankRegistrationVersion='threshold-record-v2';
 save();
}
function ensureDefaultRanking(){
 const mode=state.rankingModeVersion;
 if(mode==='daily-score-v1'||mode==='daily-score-v2'){
  state.rankingModeVersion='daily-score-v2';
  return;
 }
 state.ranking=DEFAULT_RANKING_SEED.map(r=>({...r}));
 state.rankingModeVersion='daily-score-v2';
 state.todaySubmittedBest=0;
 state.rankRegisteredBest=11;
 save();
}
function currentRankCutoff(){
 const rows=rankingSorted();
 return rows.length<10?0:(rows[9]?.score||0);
}

ensureRankRegistrationState();

const BASE_GAME_CODES=['basket','fish','stack','run','slice','tteok','powerduck'];
const BONUS_GAME_CODES=['spacefighter','racing','fantasy'];
function ensureSpacefighterUnlock(){
 if(state.unlock&&state.unlock.spacefighter)return false;
 if(BASE_GAME_CODES.every(c=>state.unlock&&state.unlock[c])){
  state.unlock.spacefighter=true;save();return true
 }

}
function ensureScoreBonusUnlocks(){
 const newly=[],n=Number(state.todayScore)||0;
 if(n>=500000&&!state.unlock.racing){state.unlock.racing=true;newly.push('racing')}
 if(n>=1000000&&!state.unlock.fantasy){state.unlock.fantasy=true;newly.push('fantasy')}
 if(newly.length){
  const q=Array.isArray(state.pendingBonusUnlocks)?state.pendingBonusUnlocks:[];
  state.pendingBonusUnlocks=[...new Set([...q,...newly])];
  save()
 }
 return newly
}

function currentCalibrationSelection(){return $('#calZoneSelect')?$('#calZoneSelect').value:null}
function saveCalPoint(kind){
 if(!lastGps){$('#calOutput').textContent='먼저 GPS 위치 확인을 시작하소.';return}
 const code=currentCalibrationSelection();if(!code)return;
 const old=(state.gpsCalibration||{})[code]||{};
 if(kind==='center'){
  state.gpsCalibration[code]={type:'circle',lat:lastGps.lat,lng:lastGps.lng,radius:45,near:160,source:'field-calibration'}
 }else{
  let a=old.a||null,b=old.b||null;if(kind==='a')a={lat:lastGps.lat,lng:lastGps.lng};else b={lat:lastGps.lat,lng:lastGps.lng};
  state.gpsCalibration[code]={type:'corridor',a,b,radius:24,near:150,source:'field-calibration'};
  if(!a||!b){state.gpsCalibration[code].pending=true}
  else delete state.gpsCalibration[code].pending
 }
 save();
 $('#calOutput').textContent=JSON.stringify(state.gpsCalibration,null,2);
 renderGpsLocations(lastGps)
}
function initGpsUi(){
 if(!DEV_ALL_UNLOCKED){const p=$('.gpsCalPanel');if(p)p.style.display='none'}
 const sel=$('#calZoneSelect');if(sel){
  sel.innerHTML=GAME_ACQUIRE.map(x=>`<option value="${x.code}">${game(x.code).name} — ${x.place}</option>`).join('');
  $('#calOutput').textContent=JSON.stringify(state.gpsCalibration||{},null,2)
 }
 $('#gpsStartBtn').onclick=startGpsWatch;
 $('#calStart').onclick=()=>saveCalPoint('a');$('#calEnd').onclick=()=>saveCalPoint('b');$('#calCenter').onclick=()=>saveCalPoint('center');
 renderGpsLocations()
}

function renderOsoShop(){
 const shop=$('#osoShop');if(!shop)return;
 const skin=currentSkin(),preview=$('#selectedOsoPreview'),name=$('#selectedOsoName'),coin=$('#shopCoin');
 if(preview)preview.src=skin.src;if(name)name.textContent=skin.name;if(coin)coin.textContent=state.coins||0;
 const groups=[
  {id:'oso',title:'🐂 오소',sub:'중앙시장의 주인공 · 기본~750 코인'},
  {id:'ayo',title:'🐱 아요 컬렉션',sub:'표정과 동작이 다양한 친구 · 1,000~1,900 코인'},
  {id:'hamo',title:'🦦 하모 컬렉션',sub:'특별한 친구 · 2,000~2,900 코인'}
 ];
 shop.innerHTML=groups.map(gr=>{
  const cards=OSO_SKINS.filter(s=>(s.group||'oso')===gr.id).map(s=>{
   const owned=state.ownedSkins.includes(s.id),selected=state.selectedSkin===s.id;
   return `<div class="skinCard ${selected?'selected':''} group-${gr.id}" data-skin="${s.id}"><span class="charBadge ${gr.id}">${s.badge||gr.title}</span><img src="${s.src}" alt="${s.name}"><b>${s.name}</b><small>${s.note}</small><button class="${selected?'selectedBtn':owned?'owned':''}" data-buy="${s.id}">${selected?'사용 중':owned?'사용하기':`🪙 ${s.price.toLocaleString()} 구입`}</button></div>`
  }).join('');
  return `<div class="shopGroupHead ${gr.id}"><b>${gr.title}</b><small>${gr.sub}</small></div>${cards}`
 }).join('');
 $$('[data-buy]').forEach(btn=>btn.onclick=()=>{
   const s=OSO_SKINS.find(x=>x.id===btn.dataset.buy);if(!s)return;
   if(state.ownedSkins.includes(s.id)){state.selectedSkin=s.id;save();refresh();tone('good');return}
   if((state.coins||0)<s.price){tone('bad');buzz(70);btn.textContent='코인이 부족하소!';setTimeout(renderOsoShop,700);return}
   state.coins-=s.price;state.ownedSkins.push(s.id);state.selectedSkin=s.id;save();tone('clear');buzz([20,15,35]);refresh()
 })
}

 }).join('');

}

--- OSO_SKINS #2 @ 1224701 ---

let gpsWatchId=null,lastGps=null,lastDirNotice={},gpsGuideTimer=null;

function gpsZones(){
 const z={...GPS_DEFAULTS};
 const cal=state.gpsCalibration||{};
 Object.keys(cal).forEach(k=>{if(cal[k])z[k]=cal[k]});
 return z
}
function rad(d){return d*Math.PI/180}
function metersBetween(a,b){
 const R=6371000,dLat=rad(b.lat-a.lat),dLon=rad(b.lng-a.lng),la1=rad(a.lat),la2=rad(b.lat);
 const h=Math.sin(dLat/2)**2+Math.cos(la1)*Math.cos(la2)*Math.sin(dLon/2)**2;
 return 2*R*Math.asin(Math.min(1,Math.sqrt(h)))
}
function pointSegmentDistanceM(p,a,b){
 const lat0=rad((a.lat+b.lat+p.lat)/3),mx=111320*Math.cos(lat0),my=110540;
 const ax=a.lng*mx,ay=a.lat*my,bx=b.lng*mx,by=b.lat*my,px=p.lng*mx,py=p.lat*my;
 const dx=bx-ax,dy=by-ay,l2=dx*dx+dy*dy;
 if(!l2)return Math.hypot(px-ax,py-ay);
 let t=((px-ax)*dx+(py-ay)*dy)/l2;t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t));
 return Math.hypot(px-(ax+t*dx),py-(ay+t*dy))
}
function zoneDistanceM(pos,z){
 if(!z)return Infinity;
 if(z.type==='circle')return Math.max(0,metersBetween(pos,{lat:z.lat,lng:z.lng})-(z.radius||0));
 if(z.type==='corridor')return Math.max(0,pointSegmentDistanceM(pos,z.a,z.b)-(z.radius||22));
 return Infinity
}
function gpsAccuracyMargin(pos){const a=Number(pos&&pos.accuracy)||0;return Math.max(0,Math.min(38,a*.62))}
function effectiveZoneDistanceM(pos,z){return Math.max(0,zoneDistanceM(pos,z)-gpsAccuracyMargin(pos))}
function zoneInside(pos,z){return !!z && effectiveZoneDistanceM(pos,z)<=0}
function zoneTarget(z){
 if(!z)return null;
 if(z.type==='circle')return {lat:z.lat,lng:z.lng};
 if(z.type==='corridor')return {lat:(z.a.lat+z.b.lat)/2,lng:(z.a.lng+z.b.lng)/2};
 return null
}
function bearingDeg(a,b){
 const y=Math.sin(rad(b.lng-a.lng))*Math.cos(rad(b.lat));
 const x=Math.cos(rad(a.lat))*Math.sin(rad(b.lat))-Math.sin(rad(a.lat))*Math.cos(rad(b.lat))*Math.cos(rad(b.lng-a.lng));
 return (Math.atan2(y,x)*180/Math.PI+360)%360
}
function arrowForBearing(d){
 const arrows=['↑','↗','→','↘','↓','↙','←','↖'];return arrows[Math.round(d/45)%8]
}

function currentSkin(){return OSO_SKINS.find(x=>x.id===state.selectedSkin)||OSO_SKINS[0]}
function currentOsoSrc(){return currentSkin().src}
const BASE_GAME_CODES=['basket','fish','stack','run','slice','tteok','powerduck'];
const BONUS_GAME_CODES=['spacefighter','racing','fantasy'];
function ensureSpacefighterUnlock(){
 if(state.unlock&&state.unlock.spacefighter)return false;
 if(BASE_GAME_CODES.every(c=>state.unlock&&state.unlock[c])){
  state.unlock.spacefighter=true;save();return true
 }
 return false
}
function ensureScoreBonusUnlocks(){
 const newly=[],n=Number(state.todayScore)||0;
 if(n>=500000&&!state.unlock.racing){state.unlock.racing=true;newly.push('racing')}
 if(n>=1000000&&!state.unlock.fantasy){state.unlock.fantasy=true;newly.push('fantasy')}
 if(newly.length){
  const q=Array.isArray(state.pendingBonusUnlocks)?state.pendingBonusUnlocks:[];
  state.pendingBonusUnlocks=[...new Set([...q,...newly])];
  save()
 }
 return newly
}

function localDateKey(){
 const d=new Date(),y=d.getFullYear(),m=String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0'),day=String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
 return `${y}-${m}-${day}`
}
function load(){try{const x=localStorage.getItem(DEV_ALL_UNLOCKED?'jcm-v168-unlocked':'jcm-v168-locked');return x?JSON.parse(x):null}catch(e){return mem}}
function save(){mem=state;try{localStorage.setItem(DEV_ALL_UNLOCKED?'jcm-v168-unlocked':'jcm-v168-locked',JSON.stringify(state))}catch(e){}}
let state=load()||{unlock:{},best:{},coins:0,todayEarned:0,todayScore:0,scoreDate:localDateKey(),pdRecord:0,coinDate:localDateKey(),ranking:[],todaySubmittedBest:0,rankRegisteredBest:11,ownedSkins:['default'],selectedSkin:'default'};
if(!state.best||typeof state.best!=='object')state.best={};
if(!Array.isArray(state.ranking))state.ranking=[];
if(!Array.isArray(state.ownedSkins))state.ownedSkins=['default'];
if(!state.gpsCalibration)state.gpsCalibration={};
if(!state.gpsUnlocked)state.gpsUnlocked={};
if(!state.qrUnlocked)state.qrUnlocked={};
if(!state.ownedSkins.includes('default'))state.ownedSkins.unshift('default');
if(!state.selectedSkin||!state.ownedSkins.includes(state.selectedSkin))state.selectedSkin='default';
if(state.todayEarned==null)state.todayEarned=0;
if(state.todayScore==null)state.todayScore=0;
if(!state.scoreDate)state.scoreDate=localDateKey();
if(state.todaySubmittedBest==null)state.todaySubmittedBest=0;
if(state.rankRegisteredBest==null){
 state.rankRegisteredBest=Number.isFinite(state.dailyRankPromptedBestRank)?state.dailyRankPromptedBestRank:11;
}
if(state.scoreDate!==localDateKey()){
 state.scoreDate=localDateKey();
}
if(!state.coinDate)state.coinDate=localDateKey();
if(state.coinDate!==localDateKey())state.coinDate=localDateKey();
if(DEV_ALL_UNLOCKED)GAMES.forEach(g=>state.unlock[g.code]=true);

function ensureDailyScoreDate(){
 const today=localDateKey();
 if(!state.scoreDate)state.scoreDate=today;
 if(state.scoreDate!==today){
  state.scoreDate=today;
  save();
 }
}

function bearingDeg(a,b){
 const y=Math.sin(rad(b.lng-a.lng))*Math.cos(rad(b.lat));
 const x=Math.cos(rad(a.lat))*Math.sin(rad(b.lat))-Math.sin(rad(a.lat))*Math.cos(rad(b.lat))*Math.cos(rad(b.lng-a.lng));
 return (Math.atan2(y,x)*180/Math.PI+360)%360
}
function arrowForBearing(d){
 const arrows=['↑','↗','→','↘','↓','↙','←','↖'];return arrows[Math.round(d/45)%8]
}

function ensureSpacefighterUnlock(){
 if(state.unlock&&state.unlock.spacefighter)return false;
 if(BASE_GAME_CODES.every(c=>state.unlock&&state.unlock[c])){
  state.unlock.spacefighter=true;save();return true
 }

}

 {initials:'잘하소',score:15000,date:'기준',ts:9,seed:true},
 {initials:'힘내소',score:10000,date:'기준',ts:10,seed:true}
];
const RANK_SCORE_THRESHOLDS=DEFAULT_RANKING_SEED.map((r,i)=>({rank:i+1,score:Number(r.score)||0}));
function rankReachedByDailyScore(score){
 const n=Number(score)||0;
 for(const t of RANK_SCORE_THRESHOLDS){if(n>t.score)return t.rank}
 return 11;
}

function ensureRankRegistrationState(){
 if(state.rankRegistrationVersion==='threshold-record-v2')return;
 const userRows=(Array.isArray(state.ranking)?state.ranking:[]).filter(r=>!r.seed);
 let inferredBestRank=11;
 for(const row of userRows){
  const rr=Number.isFinite(row.rankReached)?row.rankReached:rankReachedByDailyScore(row.score);
  inferredBestRank=Math.min(inferredBestRank,rr);
 }
 state.rankRegisteredBest=inferredBestRank;
 state.rankRegistrationVersion='threshold-record-v2';
 save();
}
function ensureDefaultRanking(){
 const mode=state.rankingModeVersion;
 if(mode==='daily-score-v1'||mode==='daily-score-v2'){
  state.rankingModeVersion='daily-score-v2';
  return;
 }
 state.ranking=DEFAULT_RANKING_SEED.map(r=>({...r}));
 state.rankingModeVersion='daily-score-v2';
 state.todaySubmittedBest=0;
 state.rankRegisteredBest=11;
 save();
}
function currentRankCutoff(){
 const rows=rankingSorted();
 return rows.length<10?0:(rows[9]?.score||0);
}

/* OSO_PRIVATE_VISIT_COUNTER_V1 */
(function(){
  try{
    if(!location.pathname.includes('/OSO-2026/play/')) return;
    const KEY='oso-private-visitor-id-v1';
    let visitorId=localStorage.getItem(KEY);
    if(!visitorId){
      visitorId=(crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() : (Date.now().toString(36)+'_'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)));
      localStorage.setItem(KEY,visitorId);
    }
    fetch('https://kfxagkjaczfwxebfvfav.supabase.co/functions/v1/record-oso-visit',{
      method:'POST',
      headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
      body:JSON.stringify({visitorId}),
      keepalive:true,
      cache:'no-store',
      credentials:'omit'
    }).catch(()=>{});
  }catch(_e){}
})();
</script>

</body></html>

function currentCalibrationSelection(){return $('#calZoneSelect')?$('#calZoneSelect').value:null}
function saveCalPoint(kind){
 if(!lastGps){$('#calOutput').textContent='먼저 GPS 위치 확인을 시작하소.';return}
 const code=currentCalibrationSelection();if(!code)return;
 const old=(state.gpsCalibration||{})[code]||{};
 if(kind==='center'){
  state.gpsCalibration[code]={type:'circle',lat:lastGps.lat,lng:lastGps.lng,radius:45,near:160,source:'field-calibration'}
 }else{
  let a=old.a||null,b=old.b||null;if(kind==='a')a={lat:lastGps.lat,lng:lastGps.lng};else b={lat:lastGps.lat,lng:lastGps.lng};
  state.gpsCalibration[code]={type:'corridor',a,b,radius:24,near:150,source:'field-calibration'};
  if(!a||!b){state.gpsCalibration[code].pending=true}
  else delete state.gpsCalibration[code].pending
 }
 save();
 $('#calOutput').textContent=JSON.stringify(state.gpsCalibration,null,2);
 renderGpsLocations(lastGps)
}
function initGpsUi(){
 if(!DEV_ALL_UNLOCKED){const p=$('.gpsCalPanel');if(p)p.style.display='none'}
 const sel=$('#calZoneSelect');if(sel){
  sel.innerHTML=GAME_ACQUIRE.map(x=>`<option value="${x.code}">${game(x.code).name} — ${x.place}</option>`).join('');
  $('#calOutput').textContent=JSON.stringify(state.gpsCalibration||{},null,2)
 }
 $('#gpsStartBtn').onclick=startGpsWatch;
 $('#calStart').onclick=()=>saveCalPoint('a');$('#calEnd').onclick=()=>saveCalPoint('b');$('#calCenter').onclick=()=>saveCalPoint('center');
 renderGpsLocations()
}

function renderOsoShop(){
 const shop=$('#osoShop');if(!shop)return;
 const skin=currentSkin(),preview=$('#selectedOsoPreview'),name=$('#selectedOsoName'),coin=$('#shopCoin');
 if(preview)preview.src=skin.src;if(name)name.textContent=skin.name;if(coin)coin.textContent=state.coins||0;
 const groups=[
  {id:'oso',title:'🐂 오소',sub:'중앙시장의 주인공 · 기본~750 코인'},
  {id:'ayo',title:'🐱 아요 컬렉션',sub:'표정과 동작이 다양한 친구 · 1,000~1,900 코인'},
  {id:'hamo',title:'🦦 하모 컬렉션',sub:'특별한 친구 · 2,000~2,900 코인'}
 ];
 shop.innerHTML=groups.map(gr=>{
  const cards=OSO_SKINS.filter(s=>(s.group||'oso')===gr.id).map(s=>{
   const owned=state.ownedSkins.includes(s.id),selected=state.selectedSkin===s.id;
   return `<div class="skinCard ${selected?'selected':''} group-${gr.id}" data-skin="${s.id}"><span class="charBadge ${gr.id}">${s.badge||gr.title}</span><img src="${s.src}" alt="${s.name}"><b>${s.name}</b><small>${s.note}</small><button class="${selected?'selectedBtn':owned?'owned':''}" data-buy="${s.id}">${selected?'사용 중':owned?'사용하기':`🪙 ${s.price.toLocaleString()} 구입`}</button></div>`
  }).join('');
  return `<div class="shopGroupHead ${gr.id}"><b>${gr.title}</b><small>${gr.sub}</small></div>${cards}`
 }).join('');
 $$('[data-buy]').forEach(btn=>btn.onclick=()=>{
   const s=OSO_SKINS.find(x=>x.id===btn.dataset.buy);if(!s)return;
   if(state.ownedSkins.includes(s.id)){state.selectedSkin=s.id;save();refresh();tone('good');return}
   if((state.coins||0)<s.price){tone('bad');buzz(70);btn.textContent='코인이 부족하소!';setTimeout(renderOsoShop,700);return}
   state.coins-=s.price;state.ownedSkins.push(s.id);state.selectedSkin=s.id;save();tone('clear');buzz([20,15,35]);refresh()
 })
}

const PERF_LITE_KEY='jcm-v249-auto-lite-v1';
window.__OSO_LOW_PERF=false;
function applyAutoLiteMode(on,remember=false){
 window.__OSO_LOW_PERF=!!on;
 document.documentElement.classList.toggle('lowPerf',!!on);
 if(remember&&on){try{localStorage.setItem(PERF_LITE_KEY,JSON.stringify({on:1,t:Date.now()}))}catch(e){}}

function initAutoLiteMode(){
 let saved=false;
 try{
  const v=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(PERF_LITE_KEY)||'null');
  saved=!!(v&&v.on&&Date.now()-Number(v.t||0)<7*24*60*60*1000);
 }catch(e){}
 if(saved){applyAutoLiteMode(true,false);return}
 const cores=Number(navigator.hardwareConcurrency)||0;
 const mem=Number(navigator.deviceMemory)||0;
 // 명백한 저사양만 사전 판정. 애매한 기기는 실제 프레임 측정으로 결정한다.
 if((cores>0&&cores<=4)||(mem>0&&mem<=2)){applyAutoLiteMode(true,true);return}
 let last=performance.now(),winStart=last,frames=0,longFrames=0,badWindows=0;
 function probe(now){
  if(window.__OSO_LOW_PERF)return;
  if(document.hidden){last=now;winStart=now;frames=0;longFrames=0;requestAnimationFrame(probe);return}
  const dt=now-last;last=now;frames++;
  if(dt>34)longFrames++;
  const span=now-winStart;
  if(span>=2200){
   const fps=frames*1000/span;
   const longRatio=frames?longFrames/frames:0;
   const bad=(fps<42)||(fps<48&&longRatio>.18);
   badWindows=bad?badWindows+1:Math.max(0,badWindows-1);
   if(badWindows>=2){applyAutoLiteMode(true,true);return}
   winStart=now;frames=0;longFrames=0;
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(probe)
 }
 setTimeout(()=>requestAnimationFrame(t=>{last=t;winStart=t;frames=0;longFrames=0;requestAnimationFrame(probe)}),1800)
}
initAutoLiteMode();

function gpsZones(){
 const z={...GPS_DEFAULTS};
 const cal=state.gpsCalibration||{};
 Object.keys(cal).forEach(k=>{if(cal[k])z[k]=cal[k]});
 return z
}
function rad(d){return d*Math.PI/180}
function metersBetween(a,b){
 const R=6371000,dLat=rad(b.lat-a.lat),dLon=rad(b.lng-a.lng),la1=rad(a.lat),la2=rad(b.lat);
 const h=Math.sin(dLat/2)**2+Math.cos(la1)*Math.cos(la2)*Math.sin(dLon/2)**2;
 return 2*R*Math.asin(Math.min(1,Math.sqrt(h)))
}
function pointSegmentDistanceM(p,a,b){
 const lat0=rad((a.lat+b.lat+p.lat)/3),mx=111320*Math.cos(lat0),my=110540;
 const ax=a.lng*mx,ay=a.lat*my,bx=b.lng*mx,by=b.lat*my,px=p.lng*mx,py=p.lat*my;
 const dx=bx-ax,dy=by-ay,l2=dx*dx+dy*dy;
 if(!l2)return Math.hypot(px-ax,py-ay);
 let t=((px-ax)*dx+(py-ay)*dy)/l2;t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t));
 return Math.hypot(px-(ax+t*dx),py-(ay+t*dy))
}
function zoneDistanceM(pos,z){
 if(!z)return Infinity;
 if(z.type==='circle')return Math.max(0,metersBetween(pos,{lat:z.lat,lng:z.lng})-(z.radius||0));
 if(z.type==='corridor')return Math.max(0,pointSegmentDistanceM(pos,z.a,z.b)-(z.radius||22));
 return Infinity
}
function gpsAccuracyMargin(pos){const a=Number(pos&&pos.accuracy)||0;return Math.max(0,Math.min(38,a*.62))}
function effectiveZoneDistanceM(pos,z){return Math.max(0,zoneDistanceM(pos,z)-gpsAccuracyMargin(pos))}
function zoneInside(pos,z){return !!z && effectiveZoneDistanceM(pos,z)<=0}
function zoneTarget(z){
 if(!z)return null;
 if(z.type==='circle')return {lat:z.lat,lng:z.lng};
 if(z.type==='corridor')return {lat:(z.a.lat+z.b.lat)/2,lng:(z.a.lng+z.b.lng)/2};
 return null
}
function bearingDeg(a,b){
 const y=Math.sin(rad(b.lng-a.lng))*Math.cos(rad(b.lat));
 const x=Math.cos(rad(a.lat))*Math.sin(rad(b.lat))-Math.sin(rad(a.lat))*Math.cos(rad(b.lat))*Math.cos(rad(b.lng-a.lng));
 return (Math.atan2(y,x)*180/Math.PI+360)%360
}
function arrowForBearing(d){
 const arrows=['↑','↗','→','↘','↓','↙','←','↖'];return arrows[Math.round(d/45)%8]
}

function ensureScoreBonusUnlocks(){
 const newly=[],n=Number(state.todayScore)||0;
 if(n>=500000&&!state.unlock.racing){state.unlock.racing=true;newly.push('racing')}

  state.pendingBonusUnlocks=[...new Set([...q,...newly])];
  save()
 }
 return newly
}

 function stackPointer(e){
  if(!alive||!current||retrying)return;
  const now=performance.now();
  if(now-lastDropAt<90)return;
  lastDropAt=now;
  e.preventDefault();
  drop()
 }
 s.style.touchAction='none';
 s.addEventListener('pointerdown',stackPointer,{capture:true,passive:false});
 function loop(ts){
  if(!alive)return;
  if(!last){last=ts;raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);return}
  const dt=Math.max(0,Math.min(.04,(ts-last)/1000));last=ts;
  if(retrying){raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);return}
  const pieceW=parseFloat(current.style.width);
  const maxX=Math.max(0,W()-pieceW);
  // 1단은 천천히 시작하고, 층수와 LEVEL이 오를수록 약 3배까지 꾸준히 가속한다.
  const speedPx=120+floor*11+(level-1)*22;
  x += dir*speedPx*dt;
  if(x<=0){x=0;dir=1}
  if(x>=maxX){x=maxX;dir=-1}
  current.style.left=x+'px';
  raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop)
 }
 hud();
 raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
 cleanup=()=>{alive=false;retrying=true;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);s.removeEventListener('pointerdown',stackPointer,true)}
}

function playTteok(){

 function speedNow(){

  $('#tteokSpeed').textContent=`속도 ×${(speedNow()/.78).toFixed(2)}`;
 }

 function impactFx(q){
  mallet.classList.add('strike');

 function hit(){
  if(!alive)return;

  // 링은 항상 바깥(2.75) → 중앙(1.0)으로만 수축.
  const scale=2.75-1.75*phase;
  const d=Math.abs(scale-1);

  let pts=0,label='MISS',color='#d84a43',gain=-9,q='miss';

  if(d<PERFECT_WINDOW){
   pts=58;label='PERFECT!';color='#ff9c00';combo++;gain=22;q='perfect';tone('perfect');
  }else if(d<GREAT_WINDOW){
   pts=36;label='GREAT!';color='#62b64d';combo++;gain=14;q='great';tone('good');
  }else if(d<GOOD_WINDOW){
   pts=18;label='GOOD';color='#4e9ad1';combo++;gain=7;q='good';tone('good');
  }else{
   combo=0;tone('bad');softShake();
  }

  let mult=feverTime>0?2:1;
  pts=(pts+Math.min(35,combo*3))*mult;
  score+=pts;
  fever=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,fever+gain));

  if(fever>=100&&feverTime<=0){
   feverTime=5;
   tone('clear');
   particles(innerWidth/2,innerHeight/2,'🔥',12);
  }

  $('#gScore').textContent=score;
  grade.textContent=feverTime>0&&pts>0?label+' ×2':label;

  }else{

   tone('bad');buzz(100);showText(`${taps}회 / ${o.need}회 실패 · +${gained}점`);setTimeout(()=>finish('powerduck',total,playPowerduck,false),650)
  }
 }
 function tick(ts){if(!running)return;let elapsed=ts-start,p=Math.max(0,1-elapsed/1000);fill.style.width=(p*100)+'%';if(elapsed>=1000){finishSecond();return}raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick)}
 target.onclick=()=>{
  if(ended)return;if(!running){running=true;start=performance.now();raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick)}
  taps++;tone('tap');buzz(5);target.classList.add('hit');setTimeout(()=>target.classList.remove('hit'),35);count.textContent=`${taps} 연타`;updatePdScorePreview();let o=targets[lv-1],p=Math.min(1,taps/o.need);crack(p);if(taps===o.need)showText(`목표 돌파! LEVEL ${lv} 점수 ×${PD_SCORE_MULT[lv]}!`)
 };
 loadStage();cleanup=()=>{ended=true;running=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf)}
}
